about: 20 held-out questions for the Oct 30 answer-quality work (multi-Act, old law vs new law, plain language). Written BEFORE any code change and never used for tuning. Ids 201-220. Expected sections are drafts, not checked by a lawyer; every expected section exists in our data and each anchor was found in its text.
reviewStatus: draft, not reviewed by a lawyer

questions.question: I bought a flat and the builder has not handed over possession on time. Can I go to the consumer court and also ask for my money back under the real estate law?

golds.act: The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act
